{'text': "These ads will launch in Apple Maps in the US and Canada later this summer. Ahead of the official rollout, Apple has revealed more about what's allowed and what's prohibited in Apple Maps ads."}

{'text': 'Apple Maps ads are coming, and Apple has also disclosed the categories that will be banned'}

{'text': 'Apple first announced plans to introduce ads in Apple Maps back in March this year. At the time, the company said ads would appear at the top of search results and in a new "Suggested Places" widget within the app.'}

{'text': 'Apple laid the groundwork for this feature in May with iOS 26.5, which added the new "Suggested Places" functionality. However, the company has not shared a launch timeline for Apple Maps ads since then.'}

{'text': 'According to TechCrunch, Apple has now updated its Apple Advertising Services policies with new information about Apple Maps ads.'}

{'text': 'The policies cover ad guidelines for Apple News, Stocks, and Maps, and list a set of prohibited content that applies to ads across all services, including violence, weapons, drugs, and more.'}

{'text': 'Most notably, the policies reveal additional restrictions specific to Apple Maps ads. According to Apple, there are three additional prohibited categories for ads within Apple Maps:'}

  • {'text': 'Home Services: Any ad content that includes or directly or indirectly promotes home services is prohibited, including but not limited to plumbing, locksmith, HVAC repair, pest control, roof repair, or general contracting.'}
  • {'text': 'Bail Bonds: Any ad content that includes or directly or indirectly promotes bail bond or surety bond services related to pretrial release from criminal custody is prohibited.'}
  • {'text': 'Crypto ATMs: Any ad content that includes or directly or indirectly promotes cryptocurrency ATMs is prohibited.'}

{'text': 'Additionally, Apple says ads related to healthcare services will be evaluated on a "case-by-case basis."'}

{'text': 'As TechCrunch points out, it\'s notable that Apple has implemented a complete ban on the entire "home services" advertising category. This is a major advertising business on Google Maps, but Apple has clearly shown no interest in it.'}

{'text': 'All of this suggests Apple is making final preparations for the launch of Apple Maps ads. However, as of now, there is still no official launch date.'}

{'text': "You can check out the full list of prohibited ad categories for all Apple services on Apple's website."}
